nodes.title: The Notebook's third page, Questions, renders Learning's GET /api/child/jar: waiting items under '{T} will bring these back' (oldest first), answered ones struck through with 'answered on {date}'. No counts, nothing to delete. The page appears only when the route answers (absent before integration 7). Reverse: the jar moves into the lesson Later tray only.

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-app-notebook-jar
When she says 'let's come back to that', the child can see that she meant it. The questions she parked wait in the Notebook, and once she has answered one in a later lesson it stays, struck through with the day. Nothing is counted, so the jar never turns into a to-do list.
